purpose: First live measurement of the Jev analytics path on frozen tasks, kept deliberately small because the provider's credit unit is undefined and the account balance cannot be inspected.
selection_rule: For each of the six frozen task categories, take the first task in the frozen spec order (lowest task_id). The rule is applied to task metadata only; no model output was seen and none was used to choose.

categories.E01: gst (supplementary track: refusal is the correct behaviour; excluded from accuracy)

budget_basis.credit_unit: not defined by the provider; balance not inspectable; no credit estimate is made

not_attempted: the remaining 21 frozen tasks and repeats 2-5; the reference tool-use baseline B2 cannot run on Jev
interpretation_limits: n=5 primary tasks, one repeat each: a pilot that shows whether the live path works end to end on each task family. It is not a benchmark result, not an accuracy estimate, and supports no comparison with any other model.
